basic_profile.bio: A 28-year-old software engineer from Austin, Texas, who recently joined Reddit to explore discussions on TV series and movies. Outside of work, they enjoy watching documentaries and are a fan of nostalgic shows like Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. They also have a growing interest in car reviews and gaming. Typically online during evenings and weekends, they are single and enjoy spending their free time discovering new content to watch or play.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: The user is knowledgeable about software development due to their educational background in computer science and their current role as a software engineer. They have a keen interest in television and film, picking up insights from various online platforms and discussions.
